title: Qlik Proxy Session Errors
dataSources: Qlik Sense logs (`qlik:scheduler`, `qlik:engine`, `qlik:proxy`), reload task history, section access audit, Qlik Cloud events (`com.qlik.v1.*`) and app/reload metrics via REST.
app: Qlik Sense Enterprise logs (Scheduler/Engine/Proxy/Repository) via Universal Forwarder; Qlik Cloud events via the Qlik Cloud REST API through HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=qlik:proxy (result=error OR http_status>=500)
| stats count as errors by http_status, virtual_proxy
| where errors>0
| sort - errors
description: Surfaces Qlik proxy session and gateway errors so authentication or routing problems affecting user access are caught quickly.
value: Proxy errors block users from opening any Qlik app; catching them early keeps the front door to analytics open.
implementation: Ingest proxy logs; schedule every 15 minutes; alert on server-error spikes. Correlate with load balancer and IdP health.
visualization: Timechart of proxy errors by status, table by virtual proxy.
grandmaExplanation: We watch the front door to your Qlik apps and flag errors that stop people getting in.
